title: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog is now generally available
body:
MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog tables is now generally available. Databricks recommends storing traces in Unity Catalog for new and production workloads: storage is unlimited, traces are stored in OpenTelemetry (OTel) format, access is governed through Unity Catalog schema and table permissions, and you can query traces with SQL, Genie, AI/BI dashboards, and any Spark-based tool. To view traces, point an MLflow experiment at a Unity Catalog trace location. For supported regions, see [Features with limited regional availability](/aws/en/resources/feature-region-support).

See [Store OpenTelemetry traces in Unity Catalog](/aws/en/mlflow3/genai/tracing/trace-unity-catalog) and [Query OpenTelemetry traces stored in Unity Catalog](/aws/en/mlflow3/genai/tracing/observe-with-traces/query-dbsql).
